profile: isolated temporary user-data directory; no default user profile used
fixture: loopback page containing three occurrences of 'needle'

steps.action: Set the search field to needle in the packaged browser renderer
steps.expected: The result status reports the first of three matches
The active match advances and the count reports the second of three
The active match moves back to the first of three

steps.action: Press Enter and then Shift+Enter in the focused find field
steps.expected: Enter advances to the next match and Shift+Enter returns to the previous match

steps.action: Dispatch Escape to the focused find field
steps.expected: The find bar closes and the renderer calls the close-search IPC path

steps.action: Inspect packaged main/preload/renderer code for Escape priority
steps.expected: When search is open, Escape sends a close request before Clean Mode, screen-fill, or panel-hide handling
steps.observed: PASS: findBarOpen is checked before those branches and app:close-find is routed to closeFind()

limitations: The renderer was controlled through Chromium DevTools Protocol because the test app could not be brought to the macOS foreground in this session.
The Escape event was dispatched to the renderer search field; physical keyboard routing through Electron before-input-event while in Clean Mode, screen-fill, or legacy panel mode was not exercised.
Focus return is implemented by the tab:find-close handler calling activeView.webContents.focus(), but OS-level focused-window state could not be observed in the background-only test process.
